name: frequency-fresh-confirmation-iid-20260928
purpose: Explicitly authorized whole-cohort three-fold IID confirmation of one fixed existing frequency-paired candidate versus native references. NOT reproduction of original official folds.

lineage.authorization: User explicitly chose three-fold-iid for the whole cohort; parent authorized release after binding readiness on2026-09-28.

preregistration.expected_cells_formula: 10 unchanged families * 3 whole-cohort IID folds * 4 unchanged methods * 4 unchanged learners * seed2027

featcopilot-frequency-paired.scope: The same existing named implementation for every dataset/task/learner; no new accuracy logic or post-outcome switches.

method_semantics_documentation_only.references: openfe-inductive-native and autofeat-native keep native output widths without the candidate's 50-feature cap; no error-to-baseline fallback.
method_semantics_documentation_only.catboost_selection_disclosure: The existing candidate selection estimator is reconstructed without cat_features and uses the candidate engine's numeric preprocessing. The final CatBoost pipeline retains its native categorical handling; selection and downstream representations differ. This is disclosed, not silently changed.
method_semantics_documentation_only.binding: These descriptions are not runtime overrides. Exact method names, shared config, declared learner searches and source/run identities are the operative bindings.

decision_gates.pairing: Arithmetic mean of scheduled split losses per family/method/learner, then equal-family relative loss improvement for aggregate comparisons.
decision_gates.positive_vs_raw: Mean relative improvement versus raw strictly >0 in every classification/regression x learner stratum.
decision_gates.family_harm: No family/learner loss increase >5% versus raw.
decision_gates.strong_references: Mean paired relative improvement >=0 versus EACH complete paired native reference in every task/learner stratum.
decision_gates.completion: All 480 planned cells must succeed with finite complete paired losses for broad claims. Errors, timeouts, RSS kills, budget skips and missing pairs block broad claims; report failures and coverage without excluding difficult families.
decision_gates.win_tie_loss: Family-level relative improvement >1% is win, <-1% loss, otherwise tie.
decision_gates.intervals: Descriptive family-block intervals only; not a significance guarantee or automatic promotion/SOTA authorization.
decision_gates.scope: All ten fixed observational origins under the explicitly amended three-fold IID protocol, not official-fold replication or a full leaderboard/all-modality SOTA claim.

preregistration.budget_scope: 24h (86400s) hard run ceiling is unchanged. At 480 cells x 900s the per-cell worst-case total is 120h; budget-skipped/interrupted cells are possible and must remain explicit failures for claim gates. Fair job interleaving is not a completion guarantee.

evaluation_policy_amendment.name: three-fold-iid
evaluation_policy_amendment.timing: Before any payload or outcome inspection for this cohort; resolves the documented six-per-test-class versus minimum-ten contradiction without dropping families or lowering thresholds.
evaluation_policy_amendment.description: All ten datasets receive new three-fold IID experimental evaluation. Classification is stratified; regression uses the existing seeded IID splitter. OpenML task IDs/data versions and complete source official split integrity checks remain unchanged. Explicit top-level preregistration.resplit_official_as_iid=true is required and constrains the whole plan to three-fold IID; no per-entry override or implicit default replacement is permitted.
evaluation_policy_amendment.metadata_expectation: The smallest reported class is60; stratified three-fold splits would give20 test and40 train records for it. This is a metadata expectation, not proof of actual payload counts, numeric validity or nested-model completion.
evaluation_policy_amendment.no_outcome_based_changes: No substitutions, exclusions, target recoding, schema changes, row caps, method/learner switches or performance-driven fold selection.

reporting.family_aggregation: Mean of all three planned split losses per family/method/learner before computing relative gains; no partial-fold substitution.
reporting.strata: classification versus regression crossed with each of linear/lightgbm/catboost/xgboost; binary and multiclass disaggregations also shown without reweighting.
reporting.mean_median: Equal-family mean and median paired relative improvements versus raw and each strong reference. Do not pool unscaled losses across datasets.
reporting.intervals: Descriptive paired family-block 95% percentile bootstrap intervals,10000 resamples,seed2027; no p-value or universal guarantee.
reporting.win_tie_loss: Relative family loss improvement >1% is win, <-1% is loss, otherwise tie.
reporting.harm: Report every >5% family/learner raw-baseline loss increase, alongside analogous harms versus references.
reporting.completion_resources: Report all480 planned outcomes, complete pair coverage, errors/RSS/timeouts/budget skips, elapsed active time, per-cell timing and memory.
reporting.scope: Experimental IID generalization only; source-specific retrospective, annotation, physical-sensor dependence and clinical non-deployment limitations remain unchanged.

datasets.name: communities-crime
datasets.prediction_time: Retrospective community-level normalized ViolentCrimesPerPop annotation from the historical published compilation; not individual criminality, causal demographic attribution or a prospective policing tool.
datasets.evaluation_limitations: Remove all five primary-source nonpredictive identifiers/fold fields, including STRING communityname. Retain original normalization/missingness. Source selection and recorded-crime biases must be disclosed; no deployment or geographic-disjoint generalization is approved.
